title: Create: Cosmere Compat
description: Bridges create's mechanics to the Cosmere's suite of mods by leafreynolds.
body:
# The Mod

Bring Create's machinery to the Cosmere! No more alloying with your bare hands! You use machines for that!


## This mod includes:
- Recipe changes to better reflect metal alloying in create. You can no longer craft blends using a normal crafting interface (Unless you use dusts). Now, you must the mechanical mixer to mix ingots in order to create Alloys. 
- Addition of crushed raw ores variants to the missing ores, along with their corresponding missing recipes. This uses most of create's already existing hidden crushed raw ore variants. The exceptions are Cadmium and Chromium, which were added and textured specifically by/for this mod.
- Manual tagging of each item/block/entity that includes metal.

# Dependencies
This mod requires [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and [Cosmere by leafreynolds](https://modrinth.com/mod/cosmere).
(Future optional dependencies are planned)

# Future plans: 
- Compatibility with other popular create addons. (I am accepting suggestions)
- Expand this idea to other big mods such as Immersive Engineering. (At that point, a different mod will be created, likely with )
